fleet.wait: Waiting for the fleet to implement
fleet.note: The fleet only implements — the daemon dispatches a planned PRD and never runs prd:create, prd:design or prd:plan — so those rows report status instead of handing you a command you should not run.

planning.title: In flight, and your move
planning.blurb: A live PRD sitting at a planning stage. The fleet only implements — it never runs prd:create, prd:design or prd:plan — so these wait on you or on a delivery cycle.

advance.title: With the fleet
advance.blurb: Planned PRDs the fleet dispatches and implements. Nothing for you to do here — this is the board telling you it is moving without you.

howLabel.board: a page hands it to you
howLabel.typed: you type it to start a session

catalogue: Anything new that might be built. It classifies it — program, slice, PRD, task, bug or idea — and files it. The one entry point when you are unsure.
A result someone gets has no home yet. Adds a row to the program register.
Work backwards from a program: what has to exist for this to be true? Produces the gaps and their build order.
One delivery cycle on a program already in execution. Releases what is ready, chases stalls, and asks you about anything blocking.
Close a program whose proof has held. Checks the proof drove the whole composed thread, not one lane of it.
Shape a program that is only a row, from its page: the narrative, the proof, the decomposition and the cuts, asked through the fleet's question channel and landed as one PR. Never typed.
Cut a planning slice inside a program — one feature, one capability, or the gaps for one customer.
Change what a cut waits on, which run proves it, or the sentence that says when it is done.
Refine a slice cut from a brief, from its page: the promise somebody can check, its rows, its bar. Never typed.
Author a PRD inside a slice. This is where a promise turns into work.
Fill a PRD stub from its page: the job story, the dimensions, the scope offer, landed at prd-drafted. Never typed.
Technical and UX design for a drafted PRD.
Backend and frontend implementation plans for a designed PRD.
Build a planned PRD through to a green PR. Autonomous by default.
The gate a PRD passes on its way out. A fresh session the implementer never touched audits the acceptance criteria.
The gate every filed issue passes through before the fleet may touch it. Dispatched on Triage, never typed.
The gate every bug or task fix passes on its way out. A fresh session, dispatched on Review.
File a bug with the forensic detail a fixer needs.
TDD bug fix through to a merged PR. Reproduce red, fix the cause, confirm green.
File a small scoped task that needs no PRD.
Build a small scoped task through to a merged PR.
Park an early idea in Linear without committing to it.
Commit and open a PR; `ship` arms auto-merge on green CI.
